mapper.insert: /* 답변 등록 */ INSERT INTO inquiry_answer ( inquiry_id, user_id, answer_content, created_at, deleted_yn ) VALUES ( #{qnaId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW(), 'N' )
mapper.select: /* 답변 상세 조회 (문의글 ID 기준) */ SELECT answer_id, inquiry_id, answer_content, created_at, user_id FROM inquiry_answer WHERE inquiry_id = #{qnaId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
